desc: Survival of a Hero: from Survival of a Mercenary, may now choose to rebirth at 20% of points as current class and race (inc. non-standard rebirths). Must be used within 4 weeks of death. If the person already has a non-standard rebirth then they may choose to keep it upon re birthing though this will be counted against the ISP limit of the new rebirth.

Focussed Determination - From Determination. Determination no longer triggers if immune to a stopping effect due to its level of effect. e.g. if 9th level resistance is possessed a 'Sleep 8 levels' causes no damage.

Enhanced Traitors Shield - From Traitors Shield now gains 12 points off the first two blows from behind and 6 points off all blows from behind. The conditions for this to apply are as Traitor's Shield.
Spiritually Cloaked - From Immunity to informational Miracles gains immunity to Spiritual informational effects except rec. spirit.
Magically Cloaked - From Immunity to information spells gains immunity to Magical informational effects except rec. mana, which only reveals Yes/No.
Undecided Destiny - From Fated Hero. Gains Immunity to Destiny Maker and similar abilities.
